_doc: VP-0 palette v1.1: ADDITIVE extension of palette.json (Module A3). It never changes a v1 ramp. Same rules: 5 steps per ramp (0 darkest shadow, 1 shadow, 2 base, 3 light, 4 highlight), shadows warm-to-purple, highlights warm, no #000000 and no #ffffff. Read by tools/vp0/*.py; the game loads palette.json first and then merges this file.
